hooks.prompt: Check if the file being edited is .env, .env.local, .env.production, or any file containing API keys, secrets, or tokens (look for patterns like API_KEY, SECRET, TOKEN, PASSWORD in the content). If so, BLOCK this edit and warn: 'Blocked: This file contains sensitive data. Edit it manually outside Claude Code.' Otherwise ALLOW.

If the file just edited is styles.css or any .css file, remind the user to verify CSS custom properties are using the existing :root variables and not introducing hardcoded colors. No action needed for non-CSS files.
